entities.summary: Anna Aleksandre Dogonadze is a Georgian-born trampoline gymnast who competed for the Soviet Union, Georgia, and Germany. She is the 2004 Olympic champion in individual trampoline, and she also competed at the 2000, 2008, and 2012 Summer Olympics. She is also a four-time World champion and a World Games champion.
